title: 국군의무사령부령 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1

Article 7 (Audits of Directly Controlled Institutions)
(1) The Minister of National Defense shall conduct security audits and internal audits relating to duties of hospitals, medical research institutes, and other necessary facilities responsible for medical treatment under Article 6 (2) 1.
(2) In the case referred to in paragraph (1), the Minister of National Defense shall, in consultation with the Chief of the Presidential Security Service, conduct security audits and internal audits relating to duties of hospitals designated to treat patients specified by the Minister of National Defense under Article 6 (2) 1, limited to matters concerning treatment of persons eligible for protection under any subparagraph of Article 4 (1) of the Act on the Security of the President, etc.
